LanguageData.GM21_TC_ChooseDesc: Choose one equipment recipe. A Crafting Grandmaster will gather its ingredients and one Magical Catalyst, then permanently commit the project.
LanguageData.GM21_TC_DialogHelp: Choose a researched equipment recipe, then its material if needed. A Crafting Grandmaster will gather the ingredients and one Magical Catalyst. Once committed, the project cannot be cancelled or refunded. Its 50% Magical outcome is revealed at completion.
LanguageData.GM21_TC_Unavailable: Requires Magical Craftsmanship research, a usable workstation, and compatible ingredient APIs.
LanguageData.GM21_TC_Idle: No project selected. Requires a Crafting Grandmaster.
LanguageData.GM21_TC_Queued: Selected: {0}\nWaiting for a Crafting Grandmaster, ingredients and one Magical Catalyst.
LanguageData.GM21_TC_Missing: Missing accessible recipe ingredients or one Magical Catalyst.
LanguageData.GM21_TC_NoDeconstruct: Committed projects cannot be deconstructed. Destroying this workstation loses the project and its ingredients.
LanguageData.GM21_TC_Faulted: Project paused: saved data or a mod callback needs attention. See Player.log. No resources will be refunded or rerolled.
LanguageData.GM21_TC_OutputWaiting: Finished item retained inside workstation. Clear space nearby for delivery.
LanguageData.GM21_TC_Recovery: Uncommitted ingredients retained after a failed start. Clear space nearby and recover them before choosing another project.
